In the conversation recorded on March 12th, 2026 at 12:30 PM, Adam Smith mentions that he is looking forward to helping out with setting up the upcoming community bake sale. Specifically, he states, "It'll be a nice way to meet some neighbors too. Looking forward to it!" However, he also says that he thinks they will manage, but he'll reach out if they need any extra hands. Li Hua agrees, saying, "Yeah, it’s always great to connect with the community! Let me know if you need any help setting things up. 😊". 

So, according to the conversation, Adam Smith offers to help with setting up for the community bake sale, although he anticipates needing additional help and plans to contact Li Hua if necessary.
